en: A vintage black‑and‑white panoramic view of a town nestled among hills with two striking volcanic rock outcrops. One rock carries a tall chapel or tower-like structure, and the other supports a large statue on its summit. Below, dense urban buildings, a prominent church, and surrounding farmland are visible. At the bottom margin, printed text identifies the scene as a view of Le Puy taken from the Côte Rochearnaud.
